items.title: Houston Person Part 2 interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, October 2, 1998 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: But the same lesson can be learned from Cannonball Adderley’s group, which was one of my favorites

ctx.x: But the same lesson can be learned from Cannonball Adderley’s group, which was one of my favorites, that most of the time just the way it was played was so—

Yeah. I like the unison, yeah. It’s stronger. I have to tell guys, lay off those thirds man. Just play it. But sometimes you’re tempted, yeah, you’re a musician and you want to show everything so you’re tempted to do it. Sometimes I do it. And I know I shouldn’t but I do it. It’s funny how you know what not to do and you go ahead and do it anyway. And then you feel like an idiot. Why did I do it?
